name: Beast
description: Living beasts of an ordinary sort.

name: Invertebrate
description: Living creatures of a primitive sort.

name: Undead
description: Death-touched entities either returned to unnatural semblance of life, or undeparted spirits of the deceased. These entities are greatly harmed by weapons of silver.

name: demigod
description: Pure spiritual beings which may manifest in the material plane. They never die, but may be banished to their home realm.

name: Oddity
description: Unnatural beings of diverse and often unknown origins.
